definitions: To measure the time taken by (an activity or process) or by (a person or machine performing it).
To choose the most effective moment for (an action or event).
To do (something) at a particular moment or within a particular period.
To set the speed of (a mechanism or device) so that it operates at the correct moment or in the correct sequence.
examples: He timed the race in 10.5 seconds.
The explosion was timed for midnight.
The engine needs to be timed correctly.
